The text outlines the following procedure for preparing for a job interview:
1. Research the company and the role you are applying for.
2. Review common interview questions and practice your responses.
3. Select professional attire and ensure it is clean and pressed for the day of the interview.
4. On the interview day, arrive early and bring copies of your resume.
5. Follow up with a thank-you note after the interview.
